text:
alex: Quick idea — can we add a small 'marginal cost peek' panel in the Cost dashboard that shows per-model marginal token cost + cache delta for a selected time window? would help PMs see the real cost impact of switching model variants.

rachel: interesting. do you mean like per-route breakouts too or just global model-level? :thinking:

alex: per-route where possible (so teams can see their route impact) + an overall model marginal view. keep it lightweight — no heavy queries by default.

jordy: backend-wise we could compute: token_count, cache_hits, model_sku_price_per_token, quantization_factor, effective_batching_factor. then do marginal_cost = price_per_token * (tokens - cache_offset) / batching_adj. rough sketch.

prashant: watch out: our sampling for econ telemetry is biased on long-tail routes. if we naively scale samples we'll misestimate marginal for low-volume routes. need sample-weighted estimator or reservoir-corrected.

maria: yep — also we should separate prefix/KV cache savings from infra-level prefetch credits. product teams will treat those differently. UX suggestion: two toggles — "include prefetch credits" and "attribute cache to route".

alex: UX mock: tiny card with sparkline (cost/hr), delta % vs baseline, and a "what-if" control: change model variant / quantization / batch size and see projected delta. clicking expands to table with per-route rows.

jordy: API idea: GET /v1/internal/costs/marginal?start=...&end=...&routes=...&group_by=model,route&include_prefetch=true&sample_correction=weighting. returns rows with: model, route, tokens_sampled, sample_weight, cache_hits, cost_estimate, ci_lower, ci_upper.

alex: love that shape. can we make the default perf-friendly: only top 20 routes by volume, and a "full" button to run a deeper job?

prashant: implementation note: for CI we can do bootstrap over samples but we need fast approximate CI for interactive UI. maybe use t-distribution on weighted mean + precomputed variance per-hour buckets. that keeps queries small.

maria: on rollout UX — if you show a canary vs control delta, surface the traffic split and sample coverage. folks get spooked by early noisy deltas. show sample count and a reliability badge (:eyes:).

rachel: alerting idea: auto-create a "marginal-cost-regression" alert when a model version increases marginal cost > X% with >Y confidence. ops can tune thresholds per-tenant.

jordy: dev note: we'll need a job to materialize hourly aggregates: per (model,route,tenant) -> tokens, cache_hits, sample_count, sum_weights, sum_weighted_cost. keeps dashboard query simple.

prashant: also avoid double-counting: prefetch credits are applied at proxy layer and again at route attribution. add lineage tags: credit_origin = [prefetch, prefix_cache, kv_cache, on_demand]. allow attribution rules.

alex: ok next steps: (1) product gets a tiny mock for card + what-if, (2) eng-platform spike: prototype API + materialization job (3) add sampling-correction helper in econ lib.

maria: +1. can we add a short note in rollout docs about interpreting canary cost signals? i'd author it.

devbot: Deploy: feature/eng-platform/marginal-cost-peek -> staging succeeded (build 783a4f) :rocket:

rachel: i'll schedule a 30m sync to review API shape. who can join tomorrow 10am PT? @jordy @prashant?

jordy: I can.

prashant: Yep.

alex: thanks all — leaving a short thread summary on the ticket. :thumbsup:
